problem: Avi::parse (src/container/avi.rs) silently overwritten promised on duplicate avih chunks in hdrl, silently ignored duplicate strh or strf chunks inside LIST strl, and check_index silently ignored trailing partial index entries when (index.end - index.start) % 16 != 0. In addition, AviAudioReader::seek_to (src/playback/audio/avi_audio.rs) did not clamp seek targets below the first sample timestamp (dwStart) on PCM/G.711 streams, returning target (e.g. 0) while the next emitted packet carried pts = start (e.g. 100).
reference_provenance: Microsoft AVI RIFF File Reference: 'hdrl' list singleton MainAVIHeader ('avih'), 'strl' list singleton AVIStreamHeader ('strh') and stream format ('strf'), and 'idx1' (AVIOLDINDEX) array of 16-byte index entries.
scope: Reject duplicate avih, strh, and strf chunks and partial idx1 entries in src/container/avi.rs, and clamp PCM/G.711 seek targets to [start, end] in src/playback/audio/avi_audio.rs.
requirements: Reproduce pre-fix acceptance of duplicate avih, duplicate strh, duplicate strf, and partial idx1 entries, as well as pre-start seek landing mismatch on delayed-start AVI PCM streams before editing production code.
Reject duplicate avih in hdrl, duplicate strh/strf in strl, and non-16-byte-multiple idx1 chunks in src/container/avi.rs.

Verify the delayed-start PCM control across pre-start seek, mid-record seek, and EOF seek, and run all 6 validation gates.
